A '''freighter''' was operated around [[9 ABY]]<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|22}}</ref> by [[Quarren]] [[Shuggoth]]. The [[starship|ship]] came under attack by [[Mandalorian]] [[Axe Woves]]' [[Mandalorian fleet|privateer fleet]] as it was carrying the [[bounty hunter]]s' current target; a [[Mon Calamari]] [[Unidentified Mon Calamari nobleman|Viceroy's]] [[Unidentified Mon Calamari viceroy's son|son]] who had an affair with Shuggoth. It was ultimately forced to dock on Woves' [[Gideon's light cruiser|''Arquitens''-class cruiser]] in order for mercenaries including [[Koska Reeves]] to board it and retrieve the [[prince]], leaving Shuggoth and her crew alone.<ref name="Chapter 22">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 22: Guns for Hire}}</ref>
